title: Hoshino Ichika — We're With You〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That was so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The entire venue overflowed with everyone's love of Miku. And she answered back accordingly.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm also really glad that Honami got to enjoy herself.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I need to file away that flyer I got. Let's see... The folder I'm saving everything in should be...
<Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Luka! What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I came to hear how that concert went.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Remember how excited you were yesterday about going?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, right...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <From your expression, it must've been very good.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it was absolutely amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Can you tell me more?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, where should I start...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, actually, they just posted a lot of pictures on their official social media accounts. One second... This is where it took place.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I think this was from the encore.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Look at all the glow sticks. They're beautiful.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know, right? The venue was really big, with a powerful sound system.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The stage was also a little higher than normal. That made it much easier to see Miku as she sang!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
Being able to see the singer's expressions as they sing is one of the best parts of a live show.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And then, Miku said we should all sing the next song together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We sang while looking at the lyrics on the monitors. That was so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Wow, with all these people...?
I would've loved to hear what that was like.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They sometimes upload videos of these concerts, so I'll show you if they do.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But it might really surprise you.
Everyone's love for Miku was so loud that I could barely even hear her.
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And that's when the medley started, like a sprint to the finish line.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That's a nice idea. Medleys let you listen to a variety of songs, and the way they flow together gives the performance momentum.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly. I was so excited that I ended up waving my arms around a ton. I'm probably going to be really sore tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's proof that you thoroughly enjoyed yourself.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. It was a fun concert from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, it reminded me of how amazing Miku and the others are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <What do you mean?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: During the show, and even after it was over, all the people in the audience around me were smiling...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also saw people who were complete strangers discussing how incredible everything was.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think it's amazing how Miku and the others can bring people together like that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also want us to put on shows like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Ichika...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It might be difficult for me right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I want Leo/need's shows to bring people together through our music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I plan on doing everything I can for that. For our upcoming solo show too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm sure you and the others will succeed, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And we promise to give you girls all the support we can so you're able to put on the best show ever.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I have to keep practicing. I have to become a better guitarist and singer.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So that we're able to put on the best performance we can during our solo show.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So that the audience goes home believing that they just saw something truly incredible!)
